scope: All units read: text for sense and metre, translation and word glosses against the text. The text was not compared with the source page.

items.issue: The text has saktaḥ (“engaged in”), but translation and gloss rendered śaktaḥ (“able to”).
items.change: Now “As long as you are busy earning wealth”; gloss likewise.

items.issue: Two small slips in the colophon verse: śrīmacchaṅkarabhagavacchiṣyai / bodhita lacks the r of the instrumental plural (śiṣyair bodhita), and dhuriṇaḥ should be dhurīṇaḥ.
options: B. Keep as in the source.
items.recommend: A: both are plain misspellings; the word gloss already reads śiṣyaiḥ.
